newsitem.title: USA: Fedex lifts all cargo fuel surcharges by Aug.
newsitem.headline: Fedex lifts all cargo fuel surcharges by Aug.

text.p: A day after rival Airborne Express announced plans to end fuel surcharges, Federal Express confirmed it will remove its last fuel surcharges by Aug 1.
FedEx said that as of Sunday it removed a 10-cent per kg surcharge imposed last December on international express freight and airport-to-airport services originating in the US, Canada and Asia.
For U.S. domestic and FedEx international priority shipments, a two percent surcharge applied in February is dropped as of Aug 1, the courier said.
FedEx already had removed fuel surcharges on shipments from Europe and Latin America.
By Aug 1, FedEx will not have surcharges on any product in any market, said spokeswoman Darlene Faquin.
